title: Case Resolution of 'Atmospheric Wakes'
doc_notes: This document is an AARO case resolution report regarding three UAP incidents in the Middle East and Mediterranean Sea involving sensor artifacts interpreted as atmospheric wakes.

incidents.summary: Case One: Unidentified object exhibiting potential anomalous propulsion signature, determined to be a sensor artifact.
incidents.explanation: Sensor artifact; object not identified but not exhibiting anomalous behaviors.
incidents.quote: The object in Case One has not been identified, but AARO is certain that it was not exhibiting anomalous behaviors.

incidents.summary: Case Two: Two objects observed, one identified as military aircraft, the other unidentified but likely a small aircraft.
incidents.explanation: Sensor artifact; one object matched military aircraft, second likely small aircraft.
incidents.quote: it is assessed that both objects are most likely aircraft, one military and the other a small but unidentified aircraft.

incidents.summary: Case Three: Object identified as a commercial Airbus A380.
incidents.explanation: Sensor artifact; identified as commercial aircraft via flight data.
incidents.quote: AARO's intelligence partners have high confidence that they identified the UAP in Case Three as a specific Airbus A380
